rounds.notes:
### Playstyle
The first round is typical Junkrat play, where we're aiming for max damage and eliminations to stack up Stadium Cash; building AP ain't cheap!

### Well Rounded Loadout
I like to start with [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0), [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418), and [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) as the most balanced kit. I prefer [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) for heroes who can more easily disengage, get back to full health, and then rejoin the fight. 

### Aggressive Loadout
You can skip the up front survivability of [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) and go with [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295). After you [RIP-Tire](ability_4cb5c82c-7f20-4c83-a3d0-abb69df71e34) you gain Armor AND Ability Power, making you even stronger for the rest of the round. If you are confident in your earning and living potential, this can drum up some extra cash. 

### No Bango? Bingo!
Longtime Stadium Junkrat players will notice we're not running [Bango!](item_b48a6731-fae8-4732-aae0-ceffbf324235) here. The burn damage from Bango is based on Weapon Power which we are doing none of, so this will be adding about 9 damage per direct hit, which just isn't that impactful. Instead, we're going [Bingo!](item_1234b16b-1426-4a0c-b6c3-213180336cc6) to maximize our ability cooldown.

round_upgrades.notes: Skimps on the initial survivability, but adds armor AND Ability Power after your first Ultimate.
Added shields and quicker recharge, great for disengaging and healing up.
Since we're not building Weapon Power to scale Bango, Bingo still lets us leverage trapped targets to refresh our cooldowns, meaning more traps and mines.

### Playstyle
Now it's time for the [Steel Trap](ability_e050bfcf-8625-48b8-a168-035640828544) and [Concussion Mine](ability_9ba90b66-026b-44f6-92d6-09fc7a1eed29) to shine! The first part of the playstyle is to think of your traps as active damage dealing and not zone control. We aren't going to be leaving traps on flanks, they need to be on the point and in the team fight. With the added throw distance from [Lithium Alloy](item_cd8ef994-9ab1-4a66-bd59-90a61a6c0eae) we are looking to toss traps right in front of people charging in or right behind people backing away. Once you have someone in your trap, follow up with a quick mine or two and then primary fire them down. Remember to get those direct hits so [Bingo!](item_1234b16b-1426-4a0c-b6c3-213180336cc6) resets our cooldowns so we can do it again!

### Core Loadout
Our next power is [Double Trouble](item_850f4701-cb41-4083-ba0e-7f96b6757025) so we can have two traps out on the field and double charges to cycle through. Remember, we're not wasting traps on cooldown, we're looking for active positions to do damage. 

The most important item here is [Lithium Alloy](item_cd8ef994-9ab1-4a66-bd59-90a61a6c0eae) which adds 75 burn damage to our traps, but the most important part is that this burn damage is ability damage, so it will scale up with our ability power. 

From here on out we're basically maximizing our ability power purchase while also factoring in cooldown reduction and survivability. For round 2, we'll be keeping [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418) and [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) as the most cost efficient items and looking to add in [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6). If you can't afford Nano Cola, go for [Multi-tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56) or [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2).

### Rats to Rat Pack
While [Rat Pack](item_a08efc76-bf44-4b61-ac78-d37cbc1ea99b) seems like the obvious choice here, in my testing I have found it's not that impactful. The increased life won't make a huge difference if the enemy team is focusing your traps and the cooldown reduction just isn't good enough to sacrifice the ability power from other items

### Playstyle
Continue to use [Steel Trap](ability_e050bfcf-8625-48b8-a168-035640828544) offensively, wait for your traps to go off, and then pounce! 

### Core Loadout
From here on out we're just maximizing our ability power. For round 3 specifically, if you are Richie Rich, you can jump right to [Champion's Kit](item_8682f8c7-8811-439b-8d50-fa81cd43ddce) for that big ability power boost. If you're earning more modestly, [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) adds both AP and cooldown reduction, making it a solid choice.

We're taking [Soot Shaker](item_365d55fe-06c9-4600-8369-5f00bd0c5b19) to make sure that when we do land a target in our trap and hit them with a mine, we'll always have at least a couple grenades in the chamber to follow up with our primary fire. The added attack speed helps us land an extra shot or two. 

### Survival Loadout
If you are dying a lot and want some extra survivability, you can instead take [LumériCo Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) for the armor and sustain.

### Anti-Air Loadout
If you are facing Pharah, Freja, Lucio, or Genji and they are pressuring you too much, consider taking [Fawkes' Funny Fuel™](item_ad0f4150-4c62-4d4f-a6c5-ef2361689db6) to boost your mine damage agains them. You probably won't be getting any elims with this tactic, but you should do enough damage to make them reconsider pushing. 

Ideally you shouldn't be isolated and between a mine jump escape and [LumériCo Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) you should be able to sustain most dives.

### Playstyle
Continue to use [Steel Trap](ability_e050bfcf-8625-48b8-a168-035640828544) offensively, wait for your traps to go off, and then pounce! 

### Core Loadout
At this point we can fully swap out [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) for [LumériCo Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) if you haven't already and swap our [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6) for [Catalytic Crystal](item_3e3f4f77-cdf8-4dda-a5b0-2fb9390aefc4), bringing our ability power up to 95%.

### More Bombs
The final power isn't set in stone, although I recommend [Frags For Days](item_bc48152f-c523-4dc7-afe0-1c016906bc8a) because it doesn't change the playstyle at all, just tosses out more grenades when we're primary firing. 

Situationally you can also consider [Slapnel](item_960e424b-3533-46b1-8063-11b575225647) if you need a little extra disengage from dives. 

I think [Trap II, Esquire](item_65a639a1-2be4-45ef-bc78-719587139b05) has potential as it allows you to leave even more traps on the field, but in practice I find myself using mines more immediately, making this power more of a setup tool than something I'd use during the fight.
